mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate indicates an easing of monetary policy, which may lead to increased borrowing and investment, thereby driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are not positively correlated with the federal funds rate decline, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate suggests a weakening labor market, which could lead to decreased consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns despite a 0.2pp increase in unemployment, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates strong demand in the housing market, which may lead to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If housing starts rise but S&P 500 returns are negative, this hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in industrial production growth may indicate supply chain issues, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If industrial production growth slows but S&P 500 returns are positive, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: Real consumer spending (RSAFS) growing while the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is high may indicate inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS grows with high FEDFUNDS but S&P 500 returns are positive, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) may signal inflation, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If CPI increases rapidly but S&P 500 returns are positive, this hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) alongside rising unemployment (UNRATE) may indicate structural labor market issues, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by 100k and UNRATE increases by 0.1pp
failure_condition: If PAYEMS and UNRATE move as described but S&P 500 returns are positive, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST) during an economic expansion may lead to positive S&P 500 returns, but this effect may reverse during a recession.
failure_condition: If housing starts are high during a recession and S&P 500 returns are negative, this hypothesis is falsified.
